rationale: TierPoint's current facility page identifies Valley Forge VFO at 1000 Adams Avenue, matching the mapped building, and offers active colocation, cloud, managed-service, support, and tour functions. A Kentucky Public Service Commission filing received April 30, 2013 identifies DBSi at that exact address as Level One's data center and provider of full operational redundancy, supplying a conservative operational-no-later-than event. Its 137,000-plus-square-foot figure is a lower bound and is retained as context rather than normalized as exact building area.

Google's current Nebraska page establishes active Papillion data-center operation, and Papillion's permit report identifies continuing Google data-center work at 14865 Gold Coast Road. The Papillion campus contains multiple buildings, while neither source identifies the selected footprint or assigns it a building code. Campus evidence therefore cannot establish this building's status.

Csquare's current Dallas/Fort Worth specification identifies its unique Allen DFW2 facility at 900 Guardians Way, matching the mapped former Evoque DA1 building, and publishes active services, 24/7 support, an SLA, and 8.6 MW of utility capacity. The 43,366-square-foot figure is explicitly raised-floor space and is not treated as total building area.

Serverfarm's current LAX1 page publishes active facility services and exact building-specific capacity and area, while PeeringDB maps LAX1 to 444 North Nash Street and coordinates matching the selected footprint. The 117,500-square-foot building area and 17.3 MW IT capacity are normalized.

CyrusOne's current page identifies its operating Norwalk facility as NYM5 and publishes current services and 4 MW of IT capacity. Its operator specification maps NYM5 to 6 Norden Place, matching the selected footprint, and reports a 168,000-square-foot facility. Both exact observations are normalized.

rationale: Union Pacific's current Omaha page establishes the railroad's continuing Omaha operations but does not identify the Jack Koraleski Technology, Research & Development Center. A directory maps that name and an operational label to the selected coordinates, but no reviewed operator, assessor, permit, or other official record corroborates the exact building. The directory claim cannot resolve status alone.

Microsoft reports Prince William County construction, but the county's live building GIS identifies the selected coordinates as completed Corscale Gainesville Crossing 1 at 13760 University Boulevard, with a finaled permit and 2024 occupancy. The same GIS places Microsoft's MNZ08 at a different nearby point and labels it pending. The exact-coordinate official record therefore conflicts with the seed's Microsoft name and operator, so lifecycle status is disputed pending entity correction.

Switch's current MOD page identifies LAS VEGAS 12 as a completed Core Campus data-center facility, and Clark County's current operating permit independently states that Switch owns and operates NAP 12 among the adjacent Las Vegas facilities. The exact facility number, operator, campus, and selected footprint align.
